第37章 打残赵强-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“爹，谁啊？”

就在这时，王春晓也从院子里走了出来，没了前几日在老林子里所遇见的狼狈，稍微梳洗一番，便露出清纯面容。

但是，胸前高耸的峰峦，却无论如何都遮掩不住。

王春晓比王乃香，更有本钱。

而且，还是奶凶奶凶那种清纯风格的。

“李青山？”

王春晓看着自己一脸警惕的爹，还有门外站着的李青山，立刻开口道：“李青山，我不就是欠你两块钱吗，用得着上门来要吗？”

欠两块钱？

王守业瞳孔猛然收缩，双目圆噔道：“怎么……怎么就欠他两块钱了？啥时候借的？”

两块钱可不是小数目啊。

一斤打架都舍不得吃的大米，才一毛三一斤，这两块钱能买十几斤大米，够一家子吃上好久。

“爹，你先回去，待会我和你说！”王春晓朝着自己老爹王守业使了个眼色道。

“好！”

“要是有事情的话，你喊一声。”

王守业一边说着，一边背着手朝着屋子里走去，自己也看不懂闺女那个眼色是什么意思，但自己回避应该没错。

“青山，你咋来啦？”王春晓见自己老爹回了房间后，便一脸惊喜的望着眼前李青山道。

“这个给你，收好了。”

李青山从怀中掏出几根铅笔，还有几本作业本道。

“青山，你给我这个做什么？”王春晓微微一怔，连忙接过李青山递过来的作业本和铅笔，一脸疑惑道。

“乡里的农村高小班马上开始了，过两天我带着你和我嫂子她们一起去报名，只要今年夏天和明年冬天能够顺利毕业，你就是小学文凭，我想办法把你塞到咱们乡里的供销社当供销员，到了那个时候，你爹还能将你嫁给赵霸吗？”

“那赵霸，算个屁啊！”

李青山开口说道。

乡里的供销社，那可是香饽饽的职位，别人想要运作上去不容易，但是李青山想要运作上去，办法有的是。

“啥？”

“青山，供销员哪里是说去就能去的？”

王春晓眉头微蹙，有些不相信李青山的话道。

“这里还有一块钱，到时候留着买课本之类的，只要你能拿到毕业证，我就有办法送你去当供销员。”

李青山保证道。

要是王春晓也去了供销社当供销员，那对自己来说可是一件好事情，日后想要采购什么紧俏货，可就简单多了。

供销社内自己还认识一个许晚吟。

不过李青山看的出来，这许晚吟以后肯定不会呆在供销社，一定会出现在更好的位置上，无论是从气质还是名字上就能看得出来，出身绝对不是小门小户，怎么可能安心在供销社当供销员呢。

"Dad, who is it?"

At this moment, Wang Chunxiao also walked out of the yard. He was no longer as embarrassed as he had been in the old forest a few days ago. After washing himself a little, he revealed his pure face.

However, the towering peaks on the chest cannot be covered up no matter what.

Wang Chunxiao has more capital than Wang Naixiang.

Moreover, she still has the innocent style of being fierce and fierce.

"Li Qingshan?"

Wang Chunxiao looked at his wary-looking father and Li Qingshan standing outside the door, and immediately said: "Li Qingshan, don't I just owe you two yuan? Do I need to come to ask for it?"

Owe two dollars?

Wang Shouye's pupils shrank suddenly, his eyes rounded as he said, "Why... why do you owe him two yuan? When did you borrow it?"

Two dollars is not a small amount of money.

A kilogram of rice that I would be reluctant to eat in a fight is only 13.1 kilograms. These two dollars can buy more than ten kilograms of rice, enough to feed the whole family for a long time.

"Dad, you go back first, I'll talk to you later!" Wang Chunxiao winked at his father, Wang Shouye.

"Okay!"

"If something happens, just shout."

As Wang Shouye spoke, he walked towards the house with his hands behind his back. He couldn't understand what his daughter's look meant, but he should be right to avoid it.

"Qingshan, why are you here?" Wang Chunxiao looked at Li Qingshan in surprise after seeing his father return to the room.

"This is for you, keep it."

Li Qingshan took out a few pencils and a few homework books from his arms.

"Qingshan, why are you giving me this?" Wang Chunxiao was slightly startled, and quickly took the exercise book and pencil handed over by Li Qingshan with a puzzled look on his face.

"The rural high school class in the village is about to start. I will take you and my sister-in-law to register in two days. As long as you graduate successfully this summer and next winter, you will have a primary school diploma. I will find a way to get you to work as a salesperson in the supply and marketing cooperative in our village. At that time, can your father still marry you to Zhao Ba?"

"Then Zhao Ba is nothing!"

Li Qingshan said.

The supply and marketing cooperative in the countryside is a very popular position. It is not easy for others to operate it, but if Li Qingshan wants to operate it, there are many ways.

"What?"

"Qingshan, where can the salesman go just by telling him to go?"

Wang Chunxiao frowned slightly, not believing what Li Qingshan said.

"There is still one dollar here, which I can save to buy textbooks and the like. As long as you can get your diploma, I will find a way to send you to work as a salesperson."

Li Qingshan promised.

If Wang Chunxiao also works as a salesperson in a supply and marketing cooperative, it will be a good thing for him. It will be much easier to purchase any hot goods in the future.

I also know Xu Wanyin in the supply and marketing cooperative.

However, Li Qingshan could tell that Xu Wanyin would definitely not stay in the supply and marketing cooperative in the future, and would definitely appear in a better position. It could be seen from his temperament and name that he was definitely not from a small family, so how could he work as a salesman in the supply and marketing cooperative with peace of mind.
